The '''Fateful Concord''' was an agreement between [[Latra Posae Decume]] and the female [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai]] with great power to stand opposed to [[Lews Therin Telamon]]'s plan to reseal the [[Bore]], and instead support a plan to defeat the [[Shadow]] with the [[Choedan Kal]] and to erect a temporary barrier around the Bore. As a result, no female Aes Sedai joined Lews Therin and the [[Hundred Companions]] when they marched on [[Shayol Ghul]]. Rand Al'Thor speculated that if both halves of the True Source had been used to make the Seal, the taint on the male half might not have occurred.[[Category:Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)| Fateful Concord]]
